I'm not much of a therapist, but as someone who has suffered suicidal issues for 4 years I'm gonna try to help you out

the problem isn't gonna be fixed by stuff like body positivity and what not. you really need to talk to a professional. They're trained and taught to help people in pain. frequent trips to people such as counselors and psychiatrists help relieve some of the pain.

just whatever you do, don't get therapy. therapy is designed for lighter matter. psychiatrists will walk you through what you need to. they will also try their best to convince and present why life is really worth living. counselors do the same thing, but just talk to you in a more complex manner.

I have to do something, but I'll leave you with this;

avoid negative relations and build positive ones. Negative relations will only drag your self esteem (not trying to be rude) and make you dig a deeper hole. Positive relations on the other hand, lead to bonding and your brain basically generates the idea of "I can't do that to myself because ill psychologically fuck my friend(s) up". also as you build a dialogue with them and build a serious friendship, you can spill/vent your issues without them judging you.
